evidence.what: Left nightstand: a horizontal bar pull standing proud of the drawer face, with a routed dark finger recess behind it and a drawer reveal line above, on the face oriented toward open room space (toward the camera / foot of the room), with clear floor in front of it.

Right nightstand: the same protruding bar pull with routed recess and shadow depth, plus the drawer reveal, on the face oriented toward open room space (toward the camera / foot of the room), not toward the bed beside it.

note: Blind pixels-only check. Camera faces the headboard wall; both nightstands flank the bed and present their pull-bearing drawer faces to the camera, i.e. into open room aisle space at the foot side - the bed sits beside each unit, not in front of the drawer. Hardware verified at 4x zoom: each pull is a 3D bar with top-edge highlight and a dark routed recess behind it (shadow depth), so this is positive front evidence, not a framed inset back panel. A person standing in the room could grasp either pull and open the drawer without the bed obstructing the pull path.
